fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Downloaded from the publisher product page https://www.redravengames.com/megaland/. The official product page shows the Megaland base-game box designed by Ryan Laukat, matching the 2018 base-game rules record. Reduced to 286 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently played a video game receives the first-player token and starts.
clarifications: During the Night phase, the current first player passes the token to the player on their left, who starts the next round.
